description: List the members of an organization (the team) plus its pending invites. Returns each member's role (owner/admin/member), name, email, and join time, plus pending invites (email or open-link, with status: expired?/uses/maxUses) and your own role on the org (viewer_role). Use this to see who's on a team before sharing or to drive an onboarding flow ('who's already in the org, what's still pending'). Read-only. Agents can invite a same-domain person with invite_to_org; removing people and changing roles are not available to agents. Any member of the org can read this; a signed agent can read their own org.

org.description: The organization slug (as shown in the dashboard URL / org settings).

name: list_org_members
